title: A Simple Guide to Buying Property in Rwanda
excerpt: The key steps to follow when buying a home or plot in Kigali, from viewing to transfer.
body: Buying property is one of the biggest decisions you will make. Working with a trusted agent helps you avoid costly mistakes.
Start by defining your budget, preferred location and the type of property you need. Then shortlist properties and arrange viewings.
Before paying, always verify ownership and the land title with the relevant authorities, and make sure every agreement is in writing.
IREME can guide you through every step, from search to handover.

title: Tips for Renting a Home in Kigali
excerpt: What to check before you sign a lease, and how to find the right rental faster.
body: Know what you can afford each month and which neighbourhoods suit your daily routine.
Inspect the property carefully: water, power, security and access roads matter as much as the interior.
Read the lease agreement fully and confirm the deposit and notice terms before signing.
Tell IREME what you need and we will help you find suitable options.

title: Why Land Remains a Smart Investment
excerpt: Land offers long-term value. Here is what to consider before you buy a plot.
body: Land is a long-term asset that can be developed when you are ready.
Check the zoning, access roads and availability of utilities before committing.
Always confirm the title and boundaries. IREME can help you verify and secure the right plot.
